budgetEvidence.hardwareTimingRationale: Two pixels per frame on both axes is the fastest diagonal cadence the packed camera supports; each column edge is prepared outside VBlank and commits at most 21 tile bytes.
budgetEvidence.productionTraceRationale: The window covers a full vertical bounce plus the horizontal reversal, so every diagonal quadrant streams a freshly entered column while the camera crosses a tile row. On the pre-fix runtime this window shows stale tiles from frame 152.
